name: Warm gently cartooned storybook realism
visualLanguage: Gently simplified silhouettes without chibi anatomy.
Believable faces, bodies, materials and restrained gestures.
Polished hand-painted game art with clean forms and subtle texture.
Gameplay readability takes priority over cinematic spectacle.

requirements: Consistent verticals, roof planes, doorways and object perspective.
Base, actor and foreground-occlusion layers remain separable.
No eye-level cinematic or side-on platformer substitution.

lighting.global: Natural motivated light with soft readable shadows and restrained contrast.

characterRules: Preserve face, age, hair, complexion, clothing layers, colors and materials.
Map sprites, special poses and portraits must depict the same identity.
Expressions remain readable but emotionally restrained.
Portraits are detailed close-ups of map identities, not unrelated actors.

generationRule.revision: Each v2+ changes one observed defect and preserves accepted details.
